full_model.description: Full replay-dependent slow branch-level structural writing (E019R canonical).
full_model.layer_note: Both structural and behavioral layers apply.

hebbian_weight_only.description: structural_lr=0; M_b frozen. Behavioral linking from E_b co-activation weight.
hebbian_weight_only.layer_note: Structural layer fails (no M_b write). Behavioral Hebbian weight tracked.

soma_global_gain_only.description: M_b writes (canonical lr) but to ALL branches uniformly via flat allocation.
soma_global_gain_only.layer_note: Structural layer: uniform write (SIG-A ≈ 0). Behavioral layer: non-specific linking.

shuffled_replay.description: Consolidation fires but trace-to-branch assignment shuffled each pass.
shuffled_replay.layer_note: Structural layer: random branch write. Behavioral: reduced specificity.

eligibility_only.description: E_b exists after encoding but structural_lr=0, replay_gain=0; purely transient.
eligibility_only.layer_note: Transient E_b-based linking at encoding time only; fades immediately.

resource_only.description: P_b (replay-driven resource) builds up; structural_lr=0; no persistent M_b.
resource_only.layer_note: Resource/P_b window linking only; no long-term persistence.
